test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 24 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A and B together can do a piece of work in 12 days, while A alone can complete the same work in 18 days. How long will B alone take to complete the work?
solution:
**Given:**

A and B together can do a piece of work in 12 days

A alone can complete the same work in 18 days

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

One day work of A = 1/18 units

One day Work of A + B = 1/12 units

One day work of B = (One day Work of A + B) - (One day Work of A) 

⇒ B = 1/12 - 1/18

⇒ B = (3 - 2)/ 36

⇒ B = 1/36 = 36 days

**∴ B alone can complete the same work in 36 days.**
